notes.title: This week in Braveland
notes.content:
Greetings, Bravelanders!

We've reached the dog days of summer, which means it's time for an update.

- New bosses have been added to Boss Adventures – be the first to beat them
- Craftsman's Boots are now available at the Heavenly Smithy
- The Barbarian has been added to the game – try to recruit him to your party
- Bugs associated with certain creatures and spells have been fixed
- Wolf Leader has been rebalanced
- Other changes and improvements

notes.title: Knights of Braveland is available now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/4f9ee6c61bd6d6b93e22359b9e91571774277e99.png

Knights of Braveland is available now!

Heroes Guild awaits you. Only you can defeat all the infamous villains threatening the kingdom.

Knights of Braveland is a cooperative beat'em up action game with a generated story. Join the Heroes Guild and travel the path from a rookie to the hero of the kingdom. Head on a hunt for the vicious boss solo or with your friends. Your adventure will be randomly generated from hundreds of different events.

You will hack, slash, and smash your way to victory. And with your friends it is much more fun. Play local or online.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1253610/Knights_of_Braveland/

Keep up with the latest news
We share updates on several different platforms. To hear about every tidbit as soon the info drops, you should join our other communities!

Discord - Twitter - Newsletter

notes.title: Autumn update
Hey Bravelanders! The summer update is here!
notes.content:
There are some new additions to the game:

Meet the Ogre! This daredevil will cause trouble for any enemy - his "Fury" ability enables him to increase his damage 1.5 times at any given moment. And if he gets his hands on enemy archers there's no escaping from him, because his "Crippling сlub" ability won't let them get away!

Spearman, a stocky dwarven archer, will now appear in chests. He moves slowly and doesn't shoot very far - what's the need for such a fighter? To fight opposing heavy infantry, of course! His armor-piercing shots zip through the thickest of shields like through jelly, and his signature "Wrathful throw" is perfect for damaging as many opponents as possible in the heat of the fight. Keep him close to the center of the arena, but don't throw him into the melee. While he can hold his punches pretty well, it's still not his specialty.

We are moving the game to a newer version of Unity, which means that the gameplay will be smoother and more stable. But most importantly, it will be much easier for us to work on future updates!

Your Braveland Heroes account can now be deleted. Don't worry, you can't delete it by mistake since you will have a few days to change your mind after you've applied for deletion.

We've also made many small changes and improvements, but the list goes on forever. Play the game and see for yourself!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33645188/f138d417e9b65ec2627cd20822a14e92b3c6975a.png

- New events added — log into the game and try to win the grand prize

notes.title: Happy new year!
notes.content:
Hi, bravelanders! Our indie team wish you happy new year. Today is a good day to summarize what our team of 10 people add in Braveland Heroes this year:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33645188/76e8bc137cbcb2fe408a5387ffa58210631e5caf.png


 The long-awaited 2v2 duel mode. You can fight both in a friendly duel within a clan, and in a special event with a random player.
 A new Hunt mode, in which you can finally get random special creatures to expand your army.
 Improved Blessing of the King with uprage levels. Get extra bonuses from the blessing for your hero.
 A new faction of Dwarves with a special hero has been opened. Their brave squad of Brigadiers is freely available to all.
 Equipment of Gladiator is available. Now you can gather even more deadly army in the new year.
 Battle Pass, which allows you not only to receive new prizes for earned stars, but also to receive many additional rewards in the premium pass.
 8 new special creatures have appeared: Digger, Rider, Spearman, Boatswain, Jarl, Undertaker, Wanderer, as well as the legendary archer - Forest Guardian
 And many other quality of life improvements.


We wish you a happy holidays, luck and wealth in the new 2022 year. We have presents for you in the game - 3 days of blessing and 1 random legendary creature. Happy new year, bravelanders!

notes.title: Greetings, Bravelanders! It's time for the fall update:
notes.content:
- The Battle Pass event has been added to the game. Earn stars and other rewards by fighting online duels, playing through the arena, taking part in hunts and boss raids, and completing daily quests. Purchase Premium Access to get even more rewards and prizes
- We're still developing 2х2 battles. You can now battle a random opponent in a new special event. Earn combat points in random 2x2 event battles and get valuable prizes
- Two new special creatures have been added: the Undertaker and the Wanderer. Try taking advantage of special offers to get your hands on them
- Battle hints for clan members have been added in raids and two-team clan duels
- Clans can now be advertised in the game
- Other changes and improvements have been made
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33645188/ab02f15783cc2f0d7103d17432e981b0bbb564a5.png

notes.title: It’s time for a hot summer update, Bravelanders!
notes.content:
- 2x2 in-clan exhibition matches have been added. Enjoy exciting battles with your clanmates
- New Special Creatures have been added: Bosun and Jarl. Try to get these amazing units for your Army
- You can now buy crystals and give them to your clanmates. Use crystals to encourage the best players in your clan, thank clanmates for helping with story battles, or even create a clan-only tournament with prizes. You can notify your entire clan about the gift or keep it between you and your clanmate
- You now have the option to apply a leadership handicap in exhibition matches — spell power is reduced to the level of the player with the lowest leadership. Now you can try out new tactics under more even conditions
- The system for detecting a player’s position during an online battle has been improved. We’ve increased the system’s accuracy by adjusting it for connection quality and server load. It’s much more accurate now
- Vibration when auto-battle ends has been added (enabled in the settings)
- Multiple resources can now be gifted at the same time within the clan
- Other changes and improvements

[previewyoutube=EV5jNwERKaA;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33645188/48c5ccd54ec5c04fc9e6f62659c4bffb6e0390dd.png

notes.title: Bravelanders, it’s time for a spring update:
Bravehearts, the time has come for the winter update
notes.content:
Bravehearts, the time has come for the winter update:
- Unlock the new King of the Gnomes hero and try recruiting special units of high-level creatures from his army: the Diligent Digger, the surly but fair Brigadier, or the brave bear Rider can join your unit.
-King’s Blessing Update. VIP-account levels were added, which can be acquired from direct purchases in the game store. The higher a player’s level, the more bonus options they will get: increased gold and experience in battle, increased warrior chest limit, full mana restoration after battle, changing store selection, and much more.
- The new Druid boss has been added to boss raids.
- Vibration was added when finding a pair. You can enable it in game settings.
- Leadership decline while helping clan members was revised.
- Clan chat was improved.
- Other changes and improvements.
[previewyoutube=mL3lOl328Lo;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Hello, Bravelanders!

Time for gifts! We prepared some surprises for you! Just hop in the game to get them.
Also, we would like to summarize what we have added during this year:
- New special creatures - Ent, Driad, Cannoneer, Demonologist, Horned
- New desert adventure chapter was introduced
- Maximum level was increased to 50, and new equipment was added to forge
- Online Arena was improved, as well as its prizes
- Story battles were reworked and global map scroll smoother now
- Online duel seasons with rules changing were introduced. Get prizes for old seasons and join the battle with new laws
- As well as online-player clan indication, battle slots expantion to 15, a bronze amulet craft ability, and much more!

Happy New Year!

notes.title: A massive autumn update for Braveland Heroes!
Braveland Heroes has a huge summer update!
notes.content:
Events:
- A pirate festival is about to begin in Braveland! Calypso, the Sea Devil, and the Thug are eager to join your army. Try your luck in special events. There’ll be a special guest at the festival: an exclusive new squad of Cannoneers. Don’t miss your chance to get it during the pirate festival!

Other changes:
- Matchmaking for online duels and the ranking calculation system have been improved
- A season bonus for dueling has been added (you can find a detailed description in the Guide in the Army building)
- You can now reset the resource-gifting timer
- Some creatures have been rebalanced
- Other changes and improvements

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33645188/2ec96d3c8b7c32669820b0795d54c78574940c35.jpg

notes.title: Bravelanders, it's time for an exciting spring update
A new event has started!
notes.content:
Hello, Bravelanders!

The new spring event is here! It is a great chance to get prizes. The most successful ones can even win a super prize! Are you ready?

- Fierce wolf packs flooded the Braveland’s territory. Horrified elders are begging the king to stop this scourge. By decree of His Majesty, anyone who dares to hunt wolves will be rewarded.

- Mercenaries that were rebelling against pay cuts, persuaded archers and bandits and organized ferocious gangs. Hunt these dangerous criminals and get your reward.

- The famous Mercenaries with their signature move “double blow” are well known to the whole Braveland. They will join the most successful commander and will accompany him through the entire story campaign and even further.

Hop into the game and complete this new event. It will only last a few days, so hurry up. Have a good game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33645188/90dec1d97cde74ebd3e7f45b4da51fab67c709e9.png

notes.title: Valentine’s Day
notes.content:
Greetings, Bravelanders! The most romantic day of the year is approaching: Valentine’s Day. That means it's time for an exciting update.
- New holiday event. Give the gift of TLC - heal units and get prizes.
- New units in the Bravelands. They say opposites attract, so we've got a nice couple for you: a furious Demon and a charming Dryad. Which of them will you get your hands on during the event?
- Lots of other improvements and fixes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33645188/a95092683b42c5059f8eec0c6438c7d0f7379b64.png

notes.title: Happy New Year!
Winter is here, Bravelanders, and that means it’s time for a pre-holiday update
notes.content:
Winter is here, Bravelanders, and that means it’s time for a pre-holiday update:

 The way medals drop in online duels has changed. Medals now depend on the percentage of the army you’ve killed.
 The cooldown system has been revised when fighting storyline battles with clanmates — if you win, you can play further through the storyline without any cooldowns.
 You now lose less Fury if you get disconnected during a Boss Raid.
 Players with a Royal Blessing can now craft and disassemble multiple pieces of equipment and resources at once.
 The storyline has been improved. The difficulty of the first few chapters has been reduced. Storyline fury has been added. If you win frequently, your fury will increase, as will the number of enemies you face. Fury and enemy numbers will decrease again over time.
 Other corrections and improvements have been introduced.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33645188/020edf9182626e40e5e8842283dbc778fb240ad9.png

notes.title: Check out Spaceland - Out Now
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

Today we would like to share some exciting news with you: our new story based strategy Spaceland has been released!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33645188/2dbd72780049d4f61d67ab898351b945a33e669d.gif

Spaceland is an incredibly dynamic turn-based strategy, reviving the traditions of XCOM, Incubation and Laser Squad. Lead a team of the most desperate fighters, destroy alien monsters and uncover the secrets of the lost planet.

Top Features:

 The game is inspired by the best turn-based strategies of the old school - XCOM, Incubation, Laser Squad
 A unique blend of dynamic turn-based battles lasting 10-15 minutes
 Make a squad from 7 space rangers, each with a unique fighting style
 The story of the mysterious planet in the spirit of the «golden age» of science fiction


Support our new game with story in Braveland style and start the space adventure!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1021070/Spaceland/

notes.title: Braveland Heroes released!
notes.content:
Hi Bravelanders!

We have released our online turn-based game Braveland Heroes.


 LEAD AN ARMY: gather dozens of game creatures and create the most powerful squad in the kingdom
 EXPLORE THE WORLD: defeat the most cunning villains
 FIGHT IN ONLINE DUELS: cross swords on the online arena with players from around the world
 JOIN A CLAN: together with your clan mates, earn chests daily and help each other in the clan's tavern
 CREATE ARTIFACTS: collect parts and create the best gear for one of your heroes
 PLAY OFFLINE: play through the plot line offline for up to 7 days, stay in the game anywhere you are
 BECOME A LEGEND: rise as high as possible up the kingdom hierarchy and become famous all over the world


And that's not the end. We will update the game and add new interesting features in future. 

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Summer Update
A new spring update is available
notes.content:
Hi, Bravelanders!

- A new chapter of adventures is available - explore the blazing tropics and find out what happened to the King’s scepter.

- The level cap has been raised to 45

- New equipment and weapons have been added

- The bear is now available to all players

- Interesting new creatures will appear in special events - try to draft them all into your army.

- The changes affect Raids and bosses. There are also new settings for boss rage, a rage meter, and much more.
